links.outcome: LLM patient-specific dose selection and titration compared with pharmacist recommendations in simulated MTM cases
links.effect: Recurrent limitations in patient-specific dose selection and titration, most consequential in multimorbidity, severe renal dysfunction, and acute deterioration; no numeric rates reported in the abstract.
links.quote: However, comparison with pharmacist recommendations showed recurrent limitations in patient-specific dose selection and titration, prioritization of simultaneous risks, intervention sequencing, and management requiring nuanced judgment.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT on simulated medication therapy management cases across varying clinical complexity; does not formally test a specific deployment safeguard/practice against a comparator.
